section_summary.extract_value: This section outlines the three primary goals of the present study: (1) examining gender differences in body-as-object versus body-as-process orientation and the relationship with exercise engagement and body appreciation; (2) investigating how weight loss talk and exercise talk predict body appreciation; and (3) testing mediation models where body-as-object orientation mediates the weight loss talk-body appreciation relationship and body-as-process orientation mediates the exercise talk-body appreciation relationship. The section does not provide empirical data, sample characteristics, or methodological details.
